changeSet.author: Alistair Wishart
changeSet.sql: UPDATE payment_frn_events pfe SET "originalValue" = (p.data->>'value')::numeric FROM payments p WHERE pfe."originalValue" IS NULL AND pfe."schemeId" = 10 AND p.type = 'uk.gov.defra.ffc.pay.payment.enriched' AND p.data->>'value' IS NOT NULL AND pfe.frn = p."partitionKey" AND pfe."correlationId" = split_part(p."rowKey", '|', 1);
